# Final-format inventory and coverage proposal

This additive proposal follows root format-07. It leaves active metadata, the historical candidate01 and all original failure/review records unchanged. All261 source rows were freshly read/hashed; public enum declarations and exact lexical lists were extracted using only the inspected pure metadata functions, with no validator/main invocation.

Three source hashes differ from candidate01: `resolve/locals.rs`, `sized/check.rs` and `sized/elaborate.rs`. These are the seven independently reviewed lint substitutions and retained root formatting. Other source hashes and all previously reviewed capacity, boundary and group prose remain unchanged. The proposal still preserves every254 active row and adds seven actual common-checker sources; twenty existing source hashes and four internal lexical surfaces differ from active inventory. Candidate01's capacity, visibility and coverage-limit conclusions remain applicable.

Preparation genuinely failed its fresh exact-surface assertion. Candidate01 had omitted duplicate signatures: one additional `Index`/`Forest` binder occurrence and one `Table`/`Forest` key occurrence in locals, plus one `Linear`/`Context` copy_budgeted occurrence. The additive failure/correction records retain the exact differences. Locals already had them in the archived pre-warning source; linear's source hash is unchanged from candidate01. This is a correction of my proposal metadata, not new source/API behavior. A bounded scanner's lists retain multiplicity even when containing types/modules are private; collapsing them into sets was incorrect. All other261-row surfaces match exactly. The old `removed_inventory_paths` label remains historical and means outside discovery domains, never deleted files.

`coverage-before.json` retains the active file's exact bytes. `PROPOSED-coverage.json` changes only `surface_sha256`, computed by the inspected pure `surface_identity` function from this proposed inventory. It binds path/group/surface plus required full hashes for entries without described functions, enums, boundaries and capacities. This includes new rows, corrected multiplicities and reviewed capacity/boundary prose; it is not semantic transport or proof of complete coverage. All routes, authority, disabled schemas, statuses, proof gates/gaps and historical/current validation disclosures remain equal as parsed values.

The inputs map records active files, historical proposal, reviewed helpers, formatting and all261 source snapshots. No validator, build, test, CLI, native process, formatter, recorded argv, active inventory or active coverage operation was performed. Root latest-attempt09 was live during preparation; actual terminal validation, MSRV, original-source capture, policy/CI and release approval remain separate. Application needs root review and the then-current exact source and evidence.

Independence is limited: I authored parts of finite/lexical/concrete implementation. The warning review is independent of root/A lint edits; this metadata proposal is not an independent semantic oracle for my own implementation. It adopts no interpretation/guarantee and claims no source preservation or Issue completion.
